rows.en: I see... It seems things are proceeding smoothly on your end as well.
As soon as our preparations are complete, we will set "Plan B" in motion.
rows.notes: Central terminology review completed; see source-linked campaign_terms.json. Historical initial draft retained.
uncertain: Plan B is source-literal second-plan designation; no independently canonical English label found. Central supplement records provenance.

rows.en: Until then, I want you to keep the Federation forces' attention focused on you.
But I cannot deal with the flies buzzing around that Hisago Plan of yours, you know?
You mean the Nadesico B?
And the "Black Ghost."
rows.notes: Ignore stray source closing wrapper and trailing @; actual kind is dialogue. Central terminology review completed; see source-linked campaign_terms.json. Historical initial draft retained.

rows.en: ...We have taken measures. As a precaution, we will send some of our men to you. You may use them however you like.
Is that all I get in return?
That matter must wait until we can control the "ruins" completely.
rows.notes: Central terminology review completed; see source-linked campaign_terms.json. Historical initial draft retained.

rows.en: Hmph... How ironic that the heroes who ended the Lizard War and the Nadesico A should spark a new war.
...Then I will end this transmission.
All for humanity's future and a new order...
rows.notes: Deliberate slogan fragment; no invented action.

rows.en: You ghosts of the Jovian Federation... Never forget that without my Giganos, your lives would hang by a thread.
rows.notes: Thought: contemptuous warning to Jovian remnants; second-person address retained.

rows.en: More pressing, however, are some young officers who object to the way we in the military high command do things.
rows.notes: Thought: restores Dorchenov and high command as actors. Meaning correction: restore source some rather than suggesting all young officers.

rows.en: To keep them in check, I may have no choice but to use Meio Plato, whom they so revere.
rows.notes: Thought: those officers revere Meio; he is the instrument to restrain them.

rows.en: Besides... His Excellency the Marshal is unlikely to object to bringing Captain Plato back to the Moon...
rows.notes: Thought: marshal remains unnamed here.

rows.en: ...You there.
Yes, sir. What is it, Lieutenant Colonel?
Send the men being dispatched to us down to Earth. Have them escort Captain Plato back to the Moon.
A-are you sure, sir?
That man told me to use them however I pleased...
He probably intends to have them spy on our movements, but I will not let him.
I will get every last bit of use out of them as errand boys.
Then I will send them to Captain Plato.
Oh, yes... Those people who offered to cooperate with us the other day had a prototype... What was its name?
Do you mean... the Medius Locus, sir?
Yes, that is it. Send it to the forward base in the Far East as well, and work it to the bone.
But it is a prototype from a special Federation project. Are you sure we need not collect data from it?
Hmph. I have no use for a defective machine like that.
Along with those Jovian ghosts, I will use it to buy time until that mobile fortress and the Gilgazamune are complete.
What is the meaning of this!? Why are the Captain and all of us being sent to the Moon!?
rows.notes: Captain and subordinate group are all ordered to the Moon.

rows.en: Are you telling us to abandon our mission to pursue the D Weapons!?
...These are Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov's orders.
We have merely come here in obedience to them.
What right have you to speak? You are not even our Giganos comrades! Where did you dogs crawl out of!?
Enough, all of you.
C-Captain!
...So Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov intends to have me persuade the young officers?
That is what we have been told.
Captain, you have no need to obey orders like these!
This is Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov's trap! He wants to lure you to the Moon and kill you if he gets the chance...!
rows.notes: Subordinates fear assassination; retain conditional opportunity and trailing alarm.

rows.en: Even that man would not act so rashly in front of His Excellency Marshal Guiltorre.
No! Dorchenov is a man who will do anything to achieve his goals!
He has already sent these mysterious strangers here, hasn't he!
rows.notes: Meaning correction: mysterious strangers preserves uncertainty about identity rather than suggesting geographic origin.

rows.en: No, this is an opportunity for me to learn the current state of our Giganos forces.
Then I must discern what Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov and the high command have in mind, persuade the young officers...
rows.notes: Sentence continues in row47; deliberate unfinished clause retained.

rows.en: And strengthen our iron unity still further under His Excellency Marshal Guiltorre.
rows.notes: Continues row46 with the duty to strengthen unity.

rows.en: Then...
rows.notes: Deliberate prompt trailing into Meio's answer.

rows.en: I will obey the orders. But first, there is something I must do. I will go to the Moon once I have accomplished it.
Something you must do?
Yes...
I want to meet that man in person and find out what he intends...
rows.notes: Man is Kaine, settled by following intelligence briefing; keep source indirect designation.

rows.en: A transmission from Giganos intelligence?
Yes. Through an underground organization in Japan, they have secretly requested contact with Kaine Wakaba.
Huh!? With me!?
...The first reason that comes to mind is that they want to abduct you, Kaine, since you're a VIP.
rows.notes: Misato identifies abduction of Kaine as immediate possible motive, not certain fact.

rows.en: VIP? Is that some kind of booze?
rows.notes: Preserve mistaken VIP/alcohol joke.

rows.en: That's VSOP... Well, that was the predictable joke.
rows.notes: VSOP is alcohol acronym; stock-joke comment retained.

rows.en: Wakaba, VIP means a very important person.
I'm a very important person? Why?
Listen, you... You're the pilot of D-1, which used to be Giganos' secret weapon, aren't you?
Right now, you're the only one who can operate it. That makes you a very important person to them, too.
rows.notes: Kaine is the only current D-1 operator; Asuka says he is valuable to both sides. No authorization status is asserted.

rows.en: O-oh, I see.
Honestly... You should be a little more aware of your position.
But hey, if I'm important to them, too... Does that mean I'm important to our side?
Of course. Why do you think we have you aboard the Nahel Argama like this?
Well, in that case, couldn't you treat me a little better...?
Stop complaining. Be grateful you haven't been jailed for operating the D Weapons without permission.
Yeah, yeah.
...By the way, Lieutenant Douglas. Who is it that wants to meet with Kaine?
Well... It is none other than the Blue Hawk of Giganos.

rows.notes: Vega's wordless shock.

rows.en: W-what did you saaaay!?
His name was Meio, if I remember right... Why does he want to meet Kaine?
rows.notes: Male referent Meio is glossary-sourced, not guessed.

rows.en: I don't know, but they have also proposed a secret ceasefire lasting just six hours.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: No matter how you look at it, this is a trap.
But they must have some reason for requesting this meeting, right? I'm a little curious about it.
Who knows? Maybe he just wants to see what D-1's pilot looks like.
Surely not...
The meeting would be in Kyoto, a neutral zone... They say they guarantee Airman Third Class Wakaba's safety, but I don't trust them.
rows.notes: Safety is promised by opposing party and doubted by Douglas.

rows.en: Yes. I think we should ignore the invitation.
W-wait a second! You're telling me to turn tail and run?!
This has nothing to do with running away. You'd be walking straight into an enemy trap.
Besides, we have nothing to gain by agreeing to the meeting.
You've gotta be kidding! We can get to Kyoto from here in no time!
Why are you so obsessed with the Blue Hawk?
rows.notes: Short Blue Hawk epithet follows the source.

rows.en: He's coming to see me by name! If I turn him down, I'll be a disgrace as a man!
Your pride doesn't matter right now.
If something happens to you, what are we supposed to do with D-1?
Heh! You think I'd go down that easily?
...I think you're already in danger if you're tempted to take him up on his invitation.
She's right, Wakaba. You could lose your life, you know?
How can I be a soldier if I'm scared of dying?! I'll go to Kyoto, even if I have to take D-1 out myself!
rows.notes: Kaine threatens an unauthorized D-1 sortie.

rows.en: ...After hearing that, do you think we'd give you permission to launch D-1?
Oh, crap.
You're usually supposed to keep quiet when you pull something like that, aren't you?
Y-yeah, you're right...
Honestly, you! Now I won't let you go, even if I have to tie you to a chair!
Yikes! Cut me some slack, Sergeant!
...So, what will you do, Captain?
I think we can agree to the meeting.
Huh?
That's our captain! You know what's what!
...Are you sure this is wise?
rows.notes: Douglas asks Bright whether approving the meeting is wise.

rows.en: Yes, there's no doubt that there's more to this invitation than meets the eye.
But I want to learn more about Giganos here, too. ...Of course, they probably plan to do the same.
rows.notes: Measured overflow compressed; both sides seeking information and the opportunity here retained.

rows.en: ...Knowing what our opponent is like would make it easier to predict their tactics, but...
Besides, if we leave things as they are, Kaine and the others might rush off on their own. That would cause us more trouble later.
Oops. So you saw right through me, huh?
Vega... I want you to go as Kaine's bodyguard. Domon will go too.
Understood.
I'll also send Light's D-3 and #男愛称's #機体名 to provide support.
rows.notes: Runtime nickname and unit placeholders preserved.

rows.en: Kaine, make absolutely sure you keep yourself under control.
Roger!
rows.notes: Acknowledgment interjection.

rows.en: The Shirahime Incident?
Yeah. Apparently, a mysterious robot attacked one of the Hisago Plan's terminal colonies.
You're talking about that "Black Ghost," right?
rows.notes: Black Ghost is a reported epithet; no identity added. Central terminology review completed; see source-linked campaign_terms.json. Historical initial draft retained.

rows.en: Yes. It seems everyone's talking about it right now.
I saw it on the news too...
A ghost, huh... I guess even colonies get haunted.
Rumor has it that ghost robot appeared with a Boson Jump.
A Boson Jump? What's that?
Put simply, it's something like teleportation.
Huh...
Well, it was also one of the reasons the Lizard War broke out.
rows.notes: Lizard War uses the glossary short variant.

rows.en: Yeah... That war was a fight over the ruins, after all.
Ruins?
Boson Jump technology was adapted from the ancient ruins on Mars...
rows.notes: Trailing continuation connects to the following explanation.

rows.en: You can't use it without certain abilities or equipment.
Right. And the best example of that is the Nadesico A...
rows.notes: Trailing introduction of Nadesico A preserved; next row identifies the ship.

rows.en: The battleship commanded by Captain Yurika Misumaru, who died in a shuttle accident.
rows.notes: Naval Captain renders the source rank for a ship captain.

rows.en: Misumaru? Wait, could she be...?
rows.notes: Source recognition question trails off; stray closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: Yeah. Captain Yurika Misumaru was the daughter of Commander Misumaru, Captain Bright's superior.
rows.notes: Commander Misumaru is Bright's superior; Yurika is his daughter.
Silence; stray source closing wrapper and indentation discarded.

rows.en: But... that shuttle accident was such a tragedy...
Yeah... I heard Captain Misumaru was on her honeymoon, too.
rows.notes: Reported honeymoon detail remains hearsay.

rows.en: Was it Akito Tenkawa... that the captain married?
Yes, he was a former member of the Nadesico A's crew...
rows.notes: Source trailing phrase preserved without adding further biography.

rows.en: There are rumors that the Titans, who were running rampant back then, may have been behind it, but...
rows.notes: Alleged Titans involvement remains a rumor, not fact.

rows.en: So the truth is still shrouded in mystery...
rows.notes: Truth remains unknown; stray closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: Light, you and the two of us have been ordered to carry out a reconnaissance mission.
rows.notes: You and us refers to Light and the two protagonist crew members.

rows.en: Me?
rows.notes: Restored only speaker question; stray closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: Yes. We'll also be escorting Kaine to Kyoto.
rows.notes: Restored we for the mission's escort purpose.

rows.en: Kyoto? Why's that guy going all the way out there...?
rows.notes: Source question deliberately trails off.

rows.en: Lieutenant Douglas will give you the details.
By the way, has #男愛称 been here?
rows.notes: Stray closing wrapper ignored; runtime nickname preserved.

rows.en: No, I haven't seen him.
Then I guess he must be in the hangar after all?
rows.notes: Male referent is the sourced male protagonist, not name inference.

rows.en: If you're looking for #男愛称, I'll help too.
I'll help too. Shall I go check his room?
rows.notes: His room refers to the male protagonist.

rows.en: Sorry to trouble you. I'm counting on you. I'll go check the hangar.
rows.notes: Request direction is Aqua asking Ginga and Leina to help.
Vocative fragment; hidden speaker remains hidden.

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'. The line is reused in i00r0a:3/16/62/97 (the interlude), so it is a neutral silence.

rows.en: ...Remember this, above all...
rows.notes: Flashback instruction; hidden speaker remains hidden.

rows.en: ...Within life, there is death...
rows.notes: Parallel life/death maxim retained.

rows.en: ...And within death, there is life...
rows.notes: Parallel death/life maxim retained.

rows.en: Find a way to live in the midst of death. Carry out the mission you've been given without fail, and make sure you come back alive.
rows.notes: Survival injunction retains mission completion and return alive.

rows.en: Death means nothing. Defeat the enemies you must defeat, and survive. Cling to life.
rows.notes: Both destroy the required enemies and cling to life retained.

rows.en: That is the iron rule of our Cry Wolves squad...
rows.notes: Cry Wolves maxim; hidden speaker label retained.

rows.en: ...And then...
rows.notes: Deliberate thought transition fragment.

rows.en: I survived...
rows.notes: First-person survival statement.

rows.en: ...In that battle against that thing... against that devil...
rows.notes: Deliberate prepositional fragment continues row157. Neutral that thing avoids unsupported gender; referent remains unnamed.
uncertain: Exact devil referent is not established in nearby context; neutral that thing preserves ambiguity.

rows.en: #男愛称... #男愛称, are you in there?
rows.notes: Offscreen caller label stays hidden; following rows establish visitors.

rows.en: Yeah, come on in.
#男愛称, what were you doing?
Oh, I was doing Zen meditation.
Zen meditation, huh? Mom made me do that at our Shaolin kung fu dojo once, too. Man, it makes your legs go numb.
Mine did at first, too. ...Anyway, did you need something?
Yes. #女愛称 was looking for you, #男愛称.
She said we've got a mission. She wants you up on the bridge right away.
Got it.
rows.notes: Ignored stray source closing bracket and trailing indent.

rows.en: So this is Seitoji Temple, huh?
rows.notes: Central terminology review completed; see source-linked campaign_terms.json. Historical initial draft retained.
uncertain: Seitoji Temple is provisional romanization; independent reading/canonical English name not found after central searches. No real temple identification added.

rows.en: Meeting with the Giganos bunch at a temple, of all places.
...I wonder if the last time I came here was before that child was born.
rows.notes: Child left unidentified, as in source; Vega slips while recalling an earlier visit.

rows.en: Huh? Vega, you've got a kid?
N-no, I don't! I mean a relative's child. A relative's!
rows.notes: Vega denies parenthood and insistently substitutes a relative.

rows.en: Hmm... A relative, huh?
...We've been expecting you.
As you can see, I've brought Airman Third Class Kaine Wakaba. ...Is he here already?
Yes.
Please, this way.
All right.
...Vega, watch his footwork... You'd better be careful.
rows.notes: His refers to the escort; Domon recognizes dangerous footwork.

rows.en: So it seems. If anything happens, I'm counting on you, Domon.
rows.notes: Vega requests Domon's assistance if needed, not offering assistance.

rows.en: Right.
...This is D-3. Looks like Kaine and the others have reached their destination.
Roger. Any heat signatures in the area?
A few in the mountains on the exact opposite side from us. That's only to be expected, of course.
rows.notes: Heat signatures are across from the allied watch position, not an assertion about a named mountain.

rows.en: Since they haven't tried anything, it looks like they really do intend to hold the meeting.
If nothing happens, do you think we'll have enough time to do a little sightseeing in Kyoto?
That sounds great. I've always wanted to see the Daimonji bonfires, for instance.
rows.notes: Preserves sightseeing example; terminology pending centralized sourcing. Central terminology review completed; see source-linked campaign_terms.json. Historical initial draft retained.

rows.en: They're farewell fires, not just bonfires. Besides, it's the wrong season. You can't see them now.
rows.notes: Preserves correction of festival naming and out-of-season objection. Central terminology review completed; see source-linked campaign_terms.json. Historical initial draft retained.

rows.en: I'm a little surprised you know so much about that, #男愛称...
...My old commanding officer was very fond of Japan.
As part of our training, I even spent some time practicing at a Zen temple near here.
Training? Was that officer... the commander of the special forces unit you used to be in, or something?
rows.notes: Aqua asks about Hugo's former unit, without identifying the hidden flashback officer.

rows.en: Huh? Did I say something I shouldn't have...?
rows.notes: Restored I for Aqua's self-question after Hugo's silence at original i024b:200.

rows.en: Anyway, Light... I'm counting on you to keep an eye on the Giganos side.
rows.notes: Restored request direction: Hugo asks Light to monitor Giganos.

rows.en: If things get ugly, they might just ignore the fact that this is a neutral zone.
Roger. Leave it to Maggie.
...So you've come, Kaine Wakaba.
You're... the Blue Hawk of Giganos?
Yes. My name is Meio... Captain Meio Plato.
P-Plato...!? Th-that's the same last name as Linda...!
rows.notes: Surname recognition preserved without prematurely revealing sibling relationship.
Intentional silence. Meio silent under orders; silence deliberately retained.

rows.en: It seems the title "Blue Hawk of Giganos" is no idle boast. That presence of his...
rows.notes: Presence is a deliberate source fragment after a complete judgment.

rows.en: He leaves no openings. He's good.
rows.notes: Restored both predicates about Meio's skill.

rows.en: ...Hey, Meio. Mind telling me why you called me out to a place like this?
...Why do you fight?

rows.notes: Punctuation-only surprise used twice, at i024b:215 and :250.

rows.en: I'm not fighting because I enjoy shooting people, and I'm not doing it because of orders, either.
And if you say it isn't out of loyalty to your country either, then why do you fight?
To save everyone's lives!
You're the ones who started this war in the first place...!
I'll fight until you back off, until I've crushed Giganos!
Foolish. You have no awareness at all of the power within you...
rows.notes: Sentence deliberately continues into row212.

rows.en: I can only call that utter ignorance.
rows.notes: Continuation of row211; restored I as the speaker making the judgment.

rows.en: What did you say!?
...I see. Fighting him has shaken your faith in your own convictions, then.
rows.notes: Domon addresses Meio about being shaken by fighting Kaine, not the reverse.

rows.en: ...You are Domon Kasshu of the Shuffle Alliance, if I recall.
And you, why do you aid the Earthnoids who do nothing but devour the Earth?
To guide human history toward a better future, doesn't your Shuffle Alliance...
rows.notes: Deliberate cross-row sentence, completed by row218.

rows.en: ...have the breadth of mind to accept both the good and the bad?
rows.notes: Continuation: accept good and bad translates the idiom without importing new policy detail.

rows.en: To preach humanity's rebirth while destroying Earth's environment with a mass driver is the height of folly.
People who look down on Earth from the heavens and rank others as superior or inferior... could never think of humanity as a whole.
rows.notes: Restored people as subject; retains superior/inferior distinction.

rows.en: Hmph... Did you learn that from the renowned Undefeated of the East, Master Asia?
But we have no time left. The First Mu War, Second Impact, the One Year War, the Lizard War...
rows.notes: War list remains source-trailing; Lizard War uses glossary permitted short variant. Central terminology review completed; see source-linked campaign_terms.json. Historical initial draft retained.
uncertain: First Mu War preserves explicit source numbering with settled Mu War naming; exact independent numbered English label unestablished.

rows.en: And the recent Gryps Conflict. The Earth Sphere and humanity have already reached their limits.
rows.notes: Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained. Central terminology review completed; see source-linked campaign_terms.json. Historical initial draft retained.

rows.en: From here on, we have no future unless we resort to drastic treatment.
You're wrong. This is no time for us Earthlings to keep fighting among ourselves...
If Gulfer and the Vegan Empire begin their invasion in earnest, this planet will...!
rows.notes: Deliberately interrupted consequence; retains both invaders.

rows.en: That's right! If we keep shooting at each other, we're playing right into their hands!
...In the end, understanding our ideals is simply beyond you...
What did you saaay!?
rows.notes: Extended anger carried by stretched say rather than adding a new explicit swear.

rows.en: ...I have one last question. Linda... Linda Plato. Is she traveling with you?
Linda!? You mean Linda!? So you really are...!!
rows.notes: Deliberate realization trails off before the relationship is stated.

rows.en: ...I think that's quite enough talk.
Who are you!?
rows.notes: Identity question aimed at the newly threatening assassins.

rows.en: Kaine Wakaba... We are taking you with us.
What!? You bastards set me up!!
What is the meaning of this?
...New orders from His Excellency Dorchenov. He means to use that one as a bargaining chip with the Federation.
rows.notes: That one is Kaine; Dorchenov plans to bargain with the Federation.

rows.en: Absurd...! I only wanted to learn who this much-too-young pilot really was.
rows.notes: Meio disavows kidnapping; youth and wish to understand Kaine retained. Meaning retained; English modifier made more idiomatic after review.

rows.en: Underestimating him in the battles ahead could mean defeat. That is why I believed I had to... see into the depths of his heart.
rows.notes: Meio answers his preceding denial of a capture plot; Kaine is the assessed opponent.

rows.en: My instincts as a warrior told me... he is a man who will always sprout, no matter what wasteland buries him.
rows.notes: Retain the barren-land/sprouting metaphor for Kaine; sourced male profile.

rows.en: Then you may judge him on the Moon. ...Reppu!
rows.notes: SRW Wiki confirms this is a call to the named member Reppu.
uncertain: Reppu romanization is provisional; no independent English spelling established.

rows.en: Right! Cheeeei!!
W-whoa!?
Ngh!?
Domon!
Heh... I recognize that as Jovian-style sword drawing.
rows.notes: Source-backed martial style, rendered literally with established Jovian faction adjective.
uncertain: Independent canonical English martial-style label unestablished.

rows.en: You bastard!
Don't think a blade of that caliber can defeat the School of the Undefeated of the East!
Guaaah!!
Insolent wretch! Follow me!
I won't let you!
Ngh! This woman uses a strange martial art!
rows.notes: Vega has just intervened; restore the attacker noticing her combat technique.

rows.en: Kaine, get away while you can!
rows.notes: Restore escape action settled by capture attempt and subsequent boarding.

rows.en: Y-yeah!
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Captain, we've hailed the unknown unit, but there's no response!
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: We have no choice. If it attacks us, intercept it!
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: Hmph, not bad. But we have Lasmunanium...!
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: Are you saying it issued a warning?
rows.notes: It refers to AI1 after Eldy reports its rejection response at s0240:428, not the Black Ghost.

rows.en: Let me tell you one thing, #男愛称.
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: In the battles ahead... hesitation will cost you your life. Don't think you can talk me around.
rows.notes: Albero warns Hugo about fatal hesitation; persuasion runs from Hugo to Albero.

rows.en: All enemy unit readings have vanished!
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: What about that unknown unit?
rows.notes: Question restores the unknown unit as the topic.

rows.en: There's still no response... Oh, wait! Bose particle readings are increasing!
rows.notes: Continues failed hail, then increasing Bose readings; all report stages retained.

rows.en: Just who could that be...?
rows.notes: Unknown pilot/presence stays unidentified.

rows.en: ...All right. We're leaving this airspace. Keep watch on the surrounding area as we go.
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Torres acknowledges.

rows.en: ...So it's over.
rows.notes: Actual kind is thought; measured with thought=True.

rows.en: But Kaine Wakaba... Don't forget. With such halfhearted conviction, you'll never be able to defeat me...
rows.notes: Actual kind is thought; Meio addresses Kaine mentally. Weak conviction cannot defeat Meio.

rows.en: ...Tell me, #男愛称.
rows.notes: Domon requests disclosure from Hugo; direction preserved.

rows.en: What happened between you and that man... and the Devil Gundam?
rows.notes: Domon asks about Hugo, Albero and the Devil Gundam; relationship rather than a new accusation.

rows.en: Could it be that, because of us, you...
rows.notes: Domon's unfinished suspicion links Hugo's hardship to Domon and his allies; unfinished clause retained.

rows.en: No... I don't hold anything against you.
rows.notes: Hugo rejects resentment specifically toward Domon.

rows.en: Besides, I know the truth behind that Devil Gundam incident too.
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: ...All right. I'll wait until you're ready to tell me.
rows.notes: Domon will wait for Hugo's voluntary disclosure.

rows.en: I'm sorry...
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: But please remember this. I... will always be here to help you.
rows.notes: Domon offers continuing support to Hugo; subject and helper direction restored.

rows.en: If there's anything I can do, just tell me.
rows.notes: Domon asks Hugo to tell him if he can help.

rows.en: Yeah...
...You won't tell even me what happened?
rows.notes: Aqua asks whether even she will be denied the explanation.

rows.en: All right. I won't try to force it out of you.
rows.notes: Aqua will not pressure Hugo into disclosure.

rows.en: And... I'm sorry I was so mouthy earlier.
rows.notes: Aqua apologizes for her earlier harsh words during Hugo's hesitation.

rows.en: No, it's all right.
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: Huh...?
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: ...He once taught me...
rows.notes: He is Albero, resolved by following i024a:26-32; taught-me clause intentionally leads into the next two rows.

rows.en: That I must always carry out my assigned mission and come back alive...
rows.notes: Continuation of row477: Albero's lesson requires mission completion and living return; fragment is a quoted content clause.

rows.en: That I must defeat the enemies I have to defeat, and survive...
rows.notes: Continuation of row477: defeat necessary enemies and survive; repeated defeat emphasis retained.

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'.

rows.en: I almost forgot that.
rows.notes: That recalls the Captains injunction to complete missions and survive, preceding477-479.

rows.en: But fighting him...
rows.notes: Aqua begins an objection about fighting his former mentor; deliberately trails off.

rows.en: I don't know why the Captain stole the Medius Locus... or why he attacked us.
But now that he's become my enemy... I won't hesitate to fight him anymore.
That's also... what the Captain taught me.
rows.notes: Restore Captain-taught principle, linked to483.

rows.en: ...You're sure about this? Really sure?
Yes. I know him better than anyone...
rows.notes: Ignore stray source closing wrapper and trailing break per brief.

rows.en: He's not the kind of man to go back on a decision once he's made it.
rows.notes: Restore he as Albero; ignore stray source closing wrapper/trailing break.

rows.en: If I hesitate when I fight the Captain... I'll only get myself killed.
Besides, today I realized something for the first time...
rows.notes: Sentence continues into490; deliberate row-boundary cutoff.

rows.en: That the #機体名 is a machine we operate together... you and me.
rows.notes: Completes489: protagonist finally acknowledges both partners operate the unit.

rows.en: Y-you only realized that today...?
rows.notes: Thought, incredulous stutter and callback to today for first time.

rows.en: ...Well, never mind. We're partners, after all.
But... when you're ready to tell me what happened, tell me properly, okay?
Like Domon... if there's anything I can do, I intend to do it, too.
rows.notes: Refers to Domons offer before packet boundary; help offered by Aqua to Hugo.

rows.en: Yeah... I understand.
...I've compiled the data on that black mobile weapon. I'll send it to Commander Misumaru as well, just in case.
Yes, please do.
rows.notes: Bright asks Misato to send data; preserve request direction.

rows.en: Just who could that have been?
Since it performed a Boson Jump... a link to Nergal or the Jovian Federation seems the most likely explanation.
rows.notes: Updated central supplement confirms same Jovian Federation faction as Mokuren; no new organization introduced.

rows.en: And... there's a strong chance it has an A-Class Jumper aboard.
An A-Class Jumper... You mean a person who can perform biological Boson Jumps?
rows.notes: Bright asks Misato to clarify the kind of person; restore You mean and can perform. Central biological Boson Jump wording confirmed as literal living-person capability; no mechanism added.
uncertain: Independent exact English biological Boson Jump label unestablished.

rows.en: Yes. They can freely jump to any place they picture in their minds...
rows.notes: Restores they and action for people identified501; trailing ellipsis retained.

rows.en: But a machine that size... capable of a Boson Jump without a Chulip... I never imagined one existed...
rows.notes: Restore Torres as shocked observer while retaining pause/trailing ellipsis.
Source silence retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: What!? Linda is the Blue Hawk's little sister!?
We don't know that for sure yet, but from the way Meio talked...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished inference based on Meios wording.

rows.en: If Kaine's guess is right, that would make him Dr. Plato's son, too.
rows.notes: He refers to Meio, not Kaine. Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: What do you mean?
Linda, the girl who used to travel with us, is actually the daughter of Dr. Plato, who built the Dragonars.
rows.notes: Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: Is that really true!?
I-I've never heard that before...
Sorry. I didn't mean any harm by keeping it from you.
rows.notes: Light apologizes for not sharing Lindas identity; no malicious intent.

rows.en: N-no... It's okay, really.
But Linda... she's in a refugee camp now, right?
Yeah, that's what we were told, but...
Then where is Dr. Plato now?
rows.notes: Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: According to Linda... he went missing after escaping from the Giganos Empire.
Could it be...?
rows.notes: Possible fate remains unstated; preserve deliberate speculative cutoff.

rows.en: No. The Federation military wouldn't just leave a VIP like the doctor to fend for himself.
The missing person story is probably a cover... I think he's helping develop mass-produced Dragonars in Chongqing.
rows.notes: Missing status is proposed cover, not established fact; I think retained.

rows.en: ...Then Meio must have a hard time showing his face in Giganos.
After all, his dad betrayed Giganos.
rows.notes: Restore complete causal explanation of Meios hardship without a standalone since clause.

rows.en: But that makes him all the more dangerous as an opponent.
Yeah... I realized that when I met Meio today.
He's more than just some pompous jerk... His convictions are stronger than we ever imagined.
rows.notes: Convictions are Meios, not the team.

rows.en: I see... So you've identified the culprit who stole the Medius.
Yes...
This is valuable information. Now... please continue your mission to track down the Medius.
Is that all you have to say?
What do you mean?
Albero Esto was #男愛称's former commanding officer.
Isn't that a little too convenient to be a coincidence?
rows.notes: Aqua suspects a staged encounter; too convenient retains suspicious implication.

rows.en: Oh...? Are you suggesting you suspect me?
You think I was secretly behind this whole affair?
rows.notes: Restore You think for complete rhetorical question about Aquas suspicion.

rows.en: There's also the matter of that mobile weapon that resembles Prototype No. 1...
rows.notes: Alludes to similar mobile weapon, not an identity proof.

rows.en: Can you really blame us for thinking that?
rows.notes: We are Aqua and Hugo; that is the suspicion voiced532-533.

rows.en: What nonsense. Losing the Medius Locus has caused me a great deal of trouble.
As a result, the development schedules for Prototypes No. 8 and No. 9 have been severely disrupted...
And then there's my reputation with our sponsors, the Federation military...
rows.notes: Restore sponsors and concern for reputation; not just budget.

rows.en: I need you to resolve this affair as quickly as possible.
...Understood.
Then that will be all.
I suppose he wouldn't give himself away that easily...
rows.notes: Thought: Aqua recognizes Mitar conceals guilt, not established narrator truth.

rows.en: No... knowing that doctor, he must have anticipated all this already...
rows.notes: Thought: prediction concerns current events; conjectural must retained.

rows.en: But just you watch... I have no intention of letting you use me and leaving it at that!
rows.notes: Thought: Aqua addresses Mitar rhetorically; promise to resist being used.
